text: The clerk posted a credit of 7 to amber10. The delivery seal for batch 2 was linen-star.
The opening posting set amber10 to 10. The opening posting set birch11 to 20. ticket-s03 belonged to amber10 at the end of this batch. The delivery seal for batch 1 was copper-leaf.

The earlier 7-unit credit to amber10 had already been posted. To reverse it, the clerk now posted a debit of 7 to amber10. This was a new posting; earlier batch records were not rewritten. birch11 was credited 2. ticket-s03 was transferred to birch11, effective before this batch ended. The delivery seal for batch 3 was violet-gate.
